reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: This sunscreen does the job and feels lightweight without leaving a white cast, which I appreciate. It’s comfortable and hydrating enough for everyday use, even if I’ve personally tried formulas that I prefer more. I like that the finish is natural and doesn’t feel greasy throughout the day. Also, the small travel size included is super convenient to keep in my bag or take with me on trips
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬做到佢嘅本分，質感輕盈又唔會泛白，我幾欣賞呢點。夠晒舒適同保濕可以日日用，不過我自己試過其他我更鍾意嘅配方。妝效自然，而且成日都唔會覺得油笠。另外，跟機嘅細裝旅行裝好方便，可以放入袋或者帶去旅行。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text:
Goes on really smooth, feel super soft and calming on the skin. The stick also has a little bit of a cooling effect. Really great for outdoor sports when you have to wear gloves and don't want to touch the sunscreen cream directly, excellent choice to carry for re-application. 

According to Incidecoder.com, this sunscreen has Uvinul A Plus, Uvinul T 150, Polysilicone-15, Tinosorb S as the sunscreen active ingredients. These seem to be safe ingredients, some publication show low or no absorbance into the blood stream. Seem to have broader UVA UVB coverage than FDA approved chemical sun screen.
reviews.zh:
上得好順滑，感覺超柔軟又舒緩肌膚。呢支防曬棒仲有少少涼感。戶外做運動要戴手套唔想直接掂到防曬cream嘅時候真係啱用，帶住補塗一流。

根據Incidecoder.com，呢款防曬嘅有效成分有Uvinul A Plus、Uvinul T 150、Polysilicone-15、Tinosorb S。睇落都係安全嘅成分，有啲研究顯示佢哋被血液吸收嘅量好低甚至冇。比起FDA認可嘅化學防曬，似乎有更廣嘅UVA UVB覆蓋。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text:
Español:
Me encantó este protector solar en barra, no tiene olor ni color y la textura es muy ligera, no te deja la piel pegajosa, le aporta un brillo suave que la hace ver saludable. Si te gusta un acabado mas mate puedes colocarte luego un poco de polvo traslúcido (oil cut). 

English:
I loved this sunscreen stick, it has no smell or color and the texture is very light, it doesn't leave your skin sticky, it gives it a soft shine that makes it look healthy. If you like a more matte finish, you can then apply a little translucent powder (oil cut).
reviews.zh:
Español:
我好鍾意呢支防曬棒，冇味冇色，質地好輕盈，唔會令皮膚黐笠笠，畀到一種柔和光澤，望落好健康。如果你鍾意霧面啲嘅妝效，可以之後掃少少透明控油粉（oil cut）。

English:
我好鍾意呢支防曬棒，冇味冇色，質地好輕盈，唔會令皮膚黐笠笠，畀到一種柔和光澤，望落好健康。如果你鍾意霧面啲嘅妝效，可以之後塗少少透明控油粉（oil cut）。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: my new favorite sun stick! the original birch sunscreen did not have a white cast so i wasn’t too worried about that but as you can see in the video, it does not leave any white cast on my hand!!! what i love most was the cooling effect it gave once i swiped my face! i wasn’t expecting that and it feels so good!!! highly recommend
reviews.zh: 我新嘅最愛防曬棒！原本嘅樺樹防曬都冇泛白，所以我都唔太擔心呢點，但係你睇片段就知道，我隻手完全冇泛白！！！我最鍾意係佢一搽上面就有涼感！完全唔係預期之內，感覺超正！！！極度推薦。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: with sun sticks you have to do a few passes to get the advertised protection. i’ve found that this sun stick leaves my skin feeling greasy after the first pass— though not intolerable. however, after a few passes to get the advertised protection, it leaves a greasy film that’s really unpleasant. i can rub and work it into my skin, but i feel like that defeats the purpose of a sun stick— applying sunscreen without needing to use my fingers to work it in.
reviews.zh: 用防曬棒要嚟返幾次先至搽到聲稱嘅防曬度數。我發現呢支防曬棒第一次搽完之後皮膚會覺得油笠——雖然唔算頂唔順。不過，要嚟返幾次先至搽到聲稱嘅防曬度數之後，就會留低一層好油笠嘅薄膜，真係好難頂。我可以捽佢再推開，但咁我覺得就違反咗用防曬棒嘅原意——用防曬棒就係唔想用手指去推開。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: It’s my first time trying out a sunscreen from Round Lab and it’s definitely amazing! At first I was thinking of buying the cream type but decided to buy the stick type instead because of its convenience. I’m usually in a hurry every morning so I just apply this sunscreen very easily before I go to work. I live in a hot and humid country but this doesn’t leave a sticky feeling on my skin. I also have an oily skin type but this doesn’t make my skin oilier at all and makes it feel moisturized and healthy instead! It’s also a plus that this doesn’t cause my skin to breakout. Round Lab sunscreen sticks don’t have the usual SPF scent like other sunscreen products, which I adore! This is one of my best purchases ever and would love to buy again!
reviews.zh: 第一次試Round Lab嘅防曬，真係好正！本來諗住買cream款，但係貪佢方便最後揀咗支裝返工。我朝早成日趕時間，所以返工前好輕易就搽完。我住喺又熱又濕嘅國家，但係佢完全唔會令皮膚黐笠笠。我自己係油性肌，但係佢完全冇令到我塊面再油，反而感覺好保濕好健康！仲有，佢唔會令我爆瘡，呢點都加分。Round Lab嘅防曬棒冇其他防曬產品常見嘅SPF味，我好鍾意！係我買過最啱用嘅嘢之一，一定會再買！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text:
This sun stick is so awesome!!! not sticky, glides on smooth, no white cast and has no smell to it !!! I am very sensitive when it comes to products with Fragrance so this sun stick is
 (TRULY FRAGRANCE FREE!!!!). Very friendly for people who are sensitive to fragrances!! I will be purchasing again when I run out!!!
reviews.zh: 呢支防曬棒勁正！！！唔黐笠，搽得好順，冇泛白又冇味！！！我對有香味嘅產品好敏感，所以呢支防曬棒係（真正冇香味！！！！）。對香味敏感嘅人真係好友善！！用完一定會再買！！！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Sun Stick 19g
reviews.text: Comprises of 51 clean ingredients; 4 UVA & UVB chemical filters, humectants and antioxidants to soothe and hydrate, niacinamide and peptides for added brightening and anti-aging benefits. It’s an invisible and lightweight application; glides effortlessly to cool and hydrate, leaving a soft finish on skin. Bonus stars to packaging—has an inner cap to prevent product from drying out.
reviews.zh: 含有51種clean ingredients；4種UVA & UVB化學防曬成分、保濕劑同抗氧化劑，可以舒緩和保濕；仲有煙酰胺同多肽幫助提亮同抗衰老。質地透薄輕盈；輕鬆滑過皮膚即時降溫補水，皮膚留低柔軟觸感。包裝額外加分——有內蓋防止產品變乾。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
